t.zh: 检测框只把物体圈在一个矩形里，说不出框里哪些像素属于物体。有的输出给每个像素一个数，是一张和照片一样大的图：0 是背景。这一关不给照片，只给这些图；其余的数是什么意思，只能从它们在图上怎样分布读出来。
t.en: A detection box only rings an object with a rectangle and cannot say which pixels inside it belong to the object. Some outputs give every pixel a number, a map as large as the photo: 0 is background. This level shows no photo, only the maps, so what the other numbers mean has to be read from how they spread across each map.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：「每个像素属于哪一类」和「每个像素属于哪一个物体」是同一个问题吗？每一轮有两个问题和几张逐像素图，图名不说它是哪一种。为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那张。
t.en: This level asks: is 'which class does each pixel belong to' the same question as 'which object does each pixel belong to'? Each round has two questions and a few per-pixel maps whose names do not say what kind they are. Give every question the map that is just enough to answer it.

after.zh: 每个像素标出属于哪一个物体，是<wiki-ref to="instance-segmentation"></wiki-ref>；只标类别，是<wiki-ref to="semantic-segmentation"></wiki-ref>。
after.en: Labelling each pixel with its object is <wiki-ref to="instance-segmentation"></wiki-ref>; labelling only its class is <wiki-ref to="semantic-segmentation"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 为每个问题选出刚好够回答它的那张逐像素图。
brief.en: For each question, choose the per-pixel map that is just enough to answer it.

hint.zh: 数一数每张图里出现了几种不为 0 的数，再看它们各占哪些格子。
hint.en: Count how many different non-zero numbers each map holds, and which cells each covers.

hint.zh: 一块连成片的区域不一定就是一个物体。
hint.en: One connected region is not necessarily one object.

prompt.zh: 图里有几只狗，每只占哪些像素？
prompt.en: How many dogs are there, and which pixels does each cover?

prompt.zh: 一根柱子挡在一只狗前面：图里一共有几只狗？
prompt.en: A post stands in front of one dog: how many dogs are there in all?

prompt.zh: 柱子以外，哪些像素是狗？
prompt.en: Apart from the post, which pixels are dog?

why.zh: 这张图只给每个像素标了类别：同一类的像素都是同一个数，挨着的两只狗连成一片，数不出有几只。
why.en: This map labels each pixel with its class only: every pixel of one class holds the same number, so two touching dogs merge into one region and cannot be counted.
